headlines.text: That Saturday in 2024, Will Ospreay vs. Kyle O'Reilly went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.07 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In his first defense of the International Title, Ospreay overcame O'Reilly's relentless assault on his surgically-repaired shoulder, escaping with a Hidden Blade to retain the championship.
On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Jon Moxley vs. Daniel Garcia headlined Dynamite, rated 8.13 ? a genuinely great match in a hard-fought men's division clash.
Back on this day in 2024, Jorel Nelson arrived in AEW, appearing on Collision, rated 5.03.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Luchasaurus reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Jurassic Express & Cage vs. reDRagon vs. The Young Bucks vs. Jurassic Express vs. Bobby Fish vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Hikuleo vs. Jungle Boy vs. Luchasaurus vs. Christian Cage vs. Darby Allin vs. Matt Hardy on Dynamite, rated 7.62 ? a solid showing.
Back on this day in 2024, it was the first-ever encounter between Garcia & Shibata and The WorkHorsemen on Collision, rated 6.77.
It was 2022 when CMFTR kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.97.
